zh.title: 漢莎航空於長途經濟艙推出全新過夜盥洗包
zh.summary: 漢莎航空長途經濟艙提供過夜盥洗包；內含品牌收納袋眼罩與耳塞
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，德國漢莎航空（Lufthansa）已宣布於長途經濟艙客艙推出全新的機上過夜盥洗包服務。漢莎航空這項新措施旨在為搭乘長途航班的經濟艙旅客帶來額外搭乘舒適體驗，並提供夜間過夜隨身個人用品。
漢莎航空發布的這款長途經濟艙過夜組包含印有品牌標誌的全新收納袋、遮光眼罩以及耳塞等個人隨身用品。該機上過夜盥洗包專為夜間執飛的長途過夜航班設計，協助旅客於長途飛行過程中獲得更好的休息與睡眠。

en.title: Lufthansa Reveals Amenity Kits for Long-Haul Economy Passengers
en.summary: Lufthansa reveals long-haul economy amenity kits featuring branded pouches, sleep masks, and earplugs.
body: Lufthansa has revealed new passenger amenity kits for its long-haul economy flights, according to reporting published by Simple Flying on August 17, 2026. The airline is introducing these amenity items for coach passengers on long-distance flights to provide added comfort during long-haul travel across its flight network.

The new long-haul coach amenity items feature specially designed branded pouches containing sleep masks and earplugs created for overnight journeys. These small comfort amenities are provided to help long-haul economy passengers rest and relax more comfortably on overnight Lufthansa flights across international routes.

zh.title: EASA發布氣候變遷對航空結冰影響報告
zh.summary: 歐洲航空安全局發布報告，探討氣候變遷如何影響飛行結冰風險。
body: 歐洲航空安全局（EASA）於2026年8月17日發布了一份新報告，探討在氣候變遷背景下大氣結冰的科學與知識現狀。該報告由歐洲航空氣候變遷影響網路（EN-ICCA）合作開發，旨在研究氣候條件變化對未來航空結冰危害的潛在影響。
報告指出，大氣結冰（包括過冷液滴、冰晶及混合相條件引起的結冰）可能會影響飛機性能、發動機可靠性與飛行安全。儘管預報能力有所提升，但在預測結冰嚴重程度及飛行中冰晶條件方面仍面臨挑戰。初步研究顯示，氣候變遷可能會影響結冰條件的頻率、高度和嚴重程度，但未來趨勢的證據目前依然有限。

en.title: EASA Publishes Report on Atmospheric Icing in Changing Climate
en.summary: EASA published a report examining how climate change could impact atmospheric icing risks for aircraft.
body: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) published a new report on August 17, 2026, examining the current state of science regarding atmospheric icing within the context of climate change. Developed under the European Network on Impact of Climate Change on Aviation (EN-ICCA), the report evaluates how evolving climatic conditions might impact this critical aviation hazard.

According to the report, atmospheric icing from supercooled liquid droplets, ice crystals, and mixed-phase conditions can degrade aircraft performance, engine reliability, and flight safety. Although forecasting has improved, challenges persist in predicting icing severity and in-flight ice crystal conditions. Preliminary research indicates that climate change could affect the frequency, altitude, and severity of icing conditions, though definitive evidence on future trends is currently limited.

zh.title: Google擬以1000萬美元購買Spirit Airlines業務數據
zh.summary: Google以1000萬美元購Spirit Airlines數據；訓練AI
body: 據路透社與FlightGlobal報導，科技業者Google計畫以1000萬美元的金額，向 Spirit Airlines 購買相關業務數據。此項金額達1000萬美元的數據交易，象徵著航空公司商業數據在科技領域的新應用發展。
根據報導資訊，Google 購買 Spirit Airlines 業務資料的主要目的，是為了訓練其旗下的人工智慧（AI）模型。這項合作將航空業營運資料導入人工智慧訓練領域，目前公開訊息尚未透露數據移轉的具體執行時程與詳細合約條件。

en.title: Google to Buy Spirit Airlines Business Data for $10 Million
en.summary: Google is purchasing Spirit Airlines business data for $10 million to train artificial intelligence models.
body: According to reports from Reuters and FlightGlobal, technology company Google has agreed to purchase business data from Spirit Airlines in a transaction valued at $10 million. The commercial agreement involves Google acquiring enterprise operational data directly from the airline to support its technology development initiatives.

The reports specify that Google is purchasing the Spirit Airlines business data for $10 million primarily to train artificial intelligence models. While the overall transaction value and basic scope of the airline data acquisition have been disclosed, additional technical terms and transfer timelines have not been detailed in the initial reports.

zh.title: 美國航空兩班機在鳳凰城重覆使用呼號 FAA展開調查
zh.summary: 美國航空兩架客機於鳳凰城空域重複使用呼號；FAA已展開調查
body: 美國聯邦航空局（FAA）已針對美國航空（American Airlines）兩架班機在鳳凰城空域重覆使用相同航管呼號的事件展開調查。根據相關資料，這起事件發生於2026年8月14日午夜過後，當時兩架隸屬於美國航空的波音737-800型客機，在鳳凰城天港國際機場（PHX）附近空域運作時，均使用相同的「American 2482」航管呼號。
呼號重覆的原因源於前段航班遭遇天候延誤。原定由芝加哥奧哈爾飛往鳳凰城的航班因天候延誤，美國航空為了避免調度連帶受阻，決定提早調派另一架已停放於鳳凰城的波音737-800客機執行返回芝加哥的航班任務。這項調度導致延誤抵達的進場客機與提早起飛的出場客機在空中同時運作，並同時使用「American 2482」呼號。
航管資料顯示，在發現呼號重覆時，進場客機正下降經過約11,000呎高度，而出場客機則正在爬升至9,000呎高度。航管人員察覺呼號混淆後，迅速於無線電通話中以「進場的 American 2482」與「離場的 American 2482」明確區分兩架班機，並全程保持兩機之間的高度隔離，成功化解空中呼號混亂問題。
美國聯邦航空局指出，在整起事件過程中，兩架客機之間均維持了符合規定的安全隔離距離，該機構目前正就詳細過程進行調查。美國航空方面也表示正在檢討相關狀況與作業流程。航管人員強調，商業航班的航管識別呼號必須具備唯一性，以確保自動化系統能精確識別與追蹤空域內的所有飛機。

en.title: FAA Investigates American Airlines Call Sign Mix-Up Over Phoenix
en.summary: American Airlines jets used identical call signs over Phoenix following weather delays; FAA opens safety investigation.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is investigating an incident involving two American Airlines flights operating with the identical air traffic control call sign over Phoenix airspace. According to reporting, the event occurred shortly after midnight on August 14, 2026, when two Boeing 737-800 aircraft were simultaneously operating as American Airlines Flight 2482 near Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX).

The call sign duplication resulted from schedule disruption caused by weather delays on an inbound flight from Chicago O'Hare (ORD) to Phoenix. Rather than waiting for the delayed inbound aircraft to land before operating the return sector, American Airlines dispatched a replacement Boeing 737-800 that was already at Phoenix to operate the outbound service to Chicago. Consequently, both the delayed arriving flight and the replacement departing flight were airborne at the same time using the same flight identification.

Flight-tracking data indicated that at the time the duplication was identified, the arriving aircraft was descending through approximately 11,000 feet, while the departing aircraft was climbing towards 9,000 feet. Upon recognizing the potential conflict on the frequency, the air traffic controller distinguished between the two aircraft by referring to them as "American 2482 on the arrival" and "American 2482 on the departure," successfully maintaining altitude separation throughout the convergence.

The FAA confirmed that required separation between the two aircraft was maintained at all times during the event and noted that an official investigation is underway. American Airlines stated that it is also reviewing the circumstances surrounding the incident. Aviation experts note that maintaining unique flight identifications for air traffic control is essential for automation systems to correctly track aircraft and manage separation in active airspace.

zh.title: 米蘭馬爾彭薩機場行李車起火 英國航空證實少量行李受損
zh.summary: 英國航空8月16日於米蘭馬爾彭薩機場發生行李車起火，少數託運行李受損無人受傷。
body: 米蘭馬爾彭薩機場1號航廈於2026年8月16日當地時間13時前發生起火事件。一輛載運英國航空（British Airways）航班卸下行李的行李車在停機坪突然起火，機場消防人員隨後趕赴現場將火勢撲滅。
地勤服務業者Aviapartner員工在火災發生時，迅速將其他行李貨櫃移離火場，防止火勢進一步蔓延。現場並未接獲人員受傷報告，起火原因最初曾被懷疑與鋰電池熱失控有關，但後續報導已排除鋰電池故障，並指出火災可能源自行李車本身的短路。
英國航空發言人證實，少量託運行李在地面受損，航空公司已主動聯繫受影響旅客提供協助。該起事件未對任何航班營運造成影響，目前相關單位正與合作夥伴展開調查以釐清詳細起火原因。

en.title: Luggage Cart Catches Fire at Milan Malpensa Airport; British Airways Confirms Baggage Damage
en.summary: British Airways confirmed a luggage cart fire at Milan Malpensa Airport damaged checked baggage on August 16.
body: A baggage cart carrying suitcases unloaded from a British Airways flight caught fire at Terminal 1 of Milan Malpensa Airport on Sunday, August 16, shortly before 13:00 local time. Airport firefighters responded to extinguish the flames on the apron, and no injuries were reported. Ground-handling staff from Aviapartner moved nearby baggage containers away from the scene to prevent the fire from spreading.

Initial speculation suggested that a damaged lithium-ion battery in passenger luggage might have caused the blaze. However, subsequent reporting ruled out a lithium-ion battery failure and attributed the fire to a potential short circuit within the baggage cart itself.

British Airways confirmed that a small number of checked bags were damaged during the incident. An airline spokesperson stated there was no impact to flight operations and that affected passengers have been contacted. An investigation with ground partners is underway to determine the cause.

zh.title: 唯一適航DH.88 Comet飛機在英國降落翻覆受損
zh.summary: DH.88 Comet飛機在英國降落翻覆；飛行員送醫後出院；調查已展開
body: 2026年8月15日，世界上唯一具備適航能力的 de Havilland DH.88 Comet 骨董飛機（註冊號 G-ACSS，名為「Grosvenor House」），在英國貝德福德郡的老沃登機場（RAF）降落時翻覆並嚴重受損。
事故發生於當地時間約 19:20 的航空展降落階段。飛機在著陸時發生輕微彈跳隨後翻覆。救援人員迅速將飛行員救出並送醫檢查，其隨後已出院。受此事故影響，原定隨後降落的 Avro Lysander 飛機改降至鄰近的達克斯福德機場。
英國航空事故調查局已針對此事故原因展開調查。這架歷史悠久的飛機曾在1934年贏得英國至澳洲的麥克羅伯森航空大賽。

en.title: World's Only Airworthy de Havilland DH.88 Comet Damaged in UK Landing Accident
en.summary: Shuttleworth's historic DH.88 Comet flipped on landing on August 15; the pilot was discharged.
body: On August 15, 2026, the world’s only airworthy de Havilland DH.88 Comet (registration G-ACSS, named "Grosvenor House") was substantially damaged after flipping over during a landing accident at Old Warden Aerodrome in Bedfordshire, United Kingdom.

The accident occurred at approximately 19:20 local time during an air display. The aircraft bounced slightly and flipped onto its back. Emergency services extracted the pilot, who was hospitalized for assessment and later discharged. An Avro Lysander scheduled to land afterward was diverted to nearby Duxford Airfield.
The UK Air Accident Investigation Branch (AAIB) has launched an investigation into the cause. The historic aircraft famously won the 1934 MacRobertson air race from England to Australia.
